system.description: An eclipse of shadow drains life across a 40' radius around you. Light sources in the area go out, leaving complete darkness.

outcomes.success: Every other creature in the area takes 3d6 damage, and you regain HP equal to half the total damage dealt.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and you regain nothing.
outcomes.ruin: The eclipse lingers over the area for a day. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
